papers.title: An open-source semi-automated workflow for multi-omics sample extraction
papers.translated_title: 用于多组学样本提取的开源半自动化工作流程
papers.author: Hall, D. R.
papers.summary: Multiomics analysis relies on extracting metabolites lipids and proteins from a single sample A widely used method for this is Metabolomics Proteomics and Lipidomics Extraction MPLEx a triphasic chloroform methanol water extraction but it is manually intensive and depends on skilled operators working around a fragile protein layer Here we present OpenMPLEx a semi automated MPLEx workflow for low cost open source Opentrons liquid handlers A minor change in chemistry pellets the protein so that a robot can collect the aqueous and organic phases from above We compared the automated workflow with two manual MPLEx protocols by liquid chromatography mass spectrometry LC MS based proteomics lipidomics and metabolomics The methods were roughly equivalent and measured similar differences between growth media We then scaled the workflow to 96 well plates and tested it on an 80 sample Pseudomonas putida experiment One operator took all 80 samples from cell pellets to LC MS data in a working week with about 3 h of hands on time rather than days at the bench and quantified about 3 900 protein groups All scripts labware definitions and print files are open source so that other laboratories can adapt the workflow
papers.translated_summary: 多组学分析依赖于从单个样本中提取代谢物、脂质和蛋白质。一种广泛使用的方法是代谢组学、蛋白质组学和脂质组学提取（MPLEx），即三相手性氯仿-甲醇-水提取，但该方法人工操作强度大，且依赖熟练操作人员在脆弱的蛋白质层周围进行操作。在此，我们提出OpenMPLEx，一种面向低成本开源Opentrons液体处理器的半自动化MPLEx工作流程。化学条件的微小改变使蛋白质形成沉淀，从而使机器人能够从上方收集水相和有机相。我们通过液相色谱-质谱联用（LC-MS）为基础的蛋白质组学、脂质组学和代谢组学，将自动化工作流程与两种手动MPLEx方案进行了比较。各方法大致等效，并测量到生长培养基之间的相似差异。随后我们将工作流程扩展至96孔板，并在一个包含80个样本的恶臭假单胞菌实验中进行测试。一名操作人员在一个工作周内完成了全部80个样本从细胞沉淀到LC-MS数据的处理，手动操作时间约3小时，而非在实验台上耗费数天，并定量了约3900个蛋白质组。所有脚本、实验室器皿定义和打印文件均为开源，以便其他实验室能够适配该工作流程。

papers.title: Considering African savanna elephant conservation as a nature-based climate solution
papers.translated_title: 将非洲稀树草原象保护视为一种基于自然的气候解决方案
papers.author: Schmitz, O.
papers.summary: The conservation of African savanna ecosystems is recognized as making important contributions toward capturing and storing atmospheric carbon in vegetation and in soils to help mitigate climate change. Also, savannas are important for elephant conservation, which is an increasing priority throughout Africa. However, there is concern that elephants can damage and transform vegetation thereby compromising savanna ecosystems capacities to capture and store carbon. Yet, elephants can have positive effects by releasing body wastes that contribute to nutrient cycling to enhance vegetation productivity (and hence carbon capture). The release of carbon in dung and trampling of soils can enhance long-term carbon storage in soils. Thus, an ecologically holistic assessment of net elephant effects on carbon capture and storage requires accounting for the negative and positive effects together. We report on a holistic assessment of elephant effects using a carbon cycle model that compares savanna ecosystem carbon capture and storage between scenarios with and without elephants. The modeling estimates that elephants at a density of approximately 0.5 individuals per square kilometer could increase average net ecosystem carbon capture by 1.4 times (range of uncertainty of 0.4 to 5.5 times). Elephants are estimated to increase average long-term aboveground carbon stocks by 6.5 times (uncertainty of 2 to 10 times). Average long-term soil carbon storage is estimated to increase by 1.7 times (uncertainty of 0.6 to 5.3 times). The estimated annual carbon capture is large enough to be considered a negative emission in national emissions accounting from land use change, suggesting that savanna elephant conservation should be considered as a nature-based climate solution.
papers.translated_summary: 非洲稀树草原生态系统的保护被认为对捕获和储存大气中的碳于植被和土壤中、帮助缓解气候变化具有重要贡献。此外，稀树草原对大象保护具有重要意义，而大象保护在整个非洲日益成为优先事项。然而，人们担心大象可能破坏和改变植被，从而损害稀树草原生态系统捕获和储存碳的能力。然而，大象也可以通过释放身体排泄物促进养分循环、提高植被生产力（进而增强碳捕获）而产生积极影响。粪便中碳的释放和土壤践踏可以增强土壤中的长期碳储存。因此，对大象碳捕获和储存净效应的生态整体评估需要将负面和正面效应一并考虑。我们报告了一项使用碳循环模型对大象效应的整体评估，该模型比较了有无大象情景下稀树草原生态系统的碳捕获和储存。模型估计，大象密度约为每平方千米0.5头时，可使平均净生态系统碳捕获增加1.4倍（不确定性范围为0.4至5.5倍）。据估计，大象可使平均长期地上碳储量增加6.5倍（不确定性为2至10倍）。平均长期土壤碳储存估计增加1.7倍（不确定性为0.6至5.3倍）。估计的年碳捕获量足够大，可在土地利用变化的国家排放核算中被视为负排放，这表明稀树草原大象保护应被视为一种基于自然的气候解决方案。

papers.title: Single-dose neonatal gene therapy preserves motor coordination and extends survival of Polg-deficient mice
papers.translated_title: 单剂量新生儿基因治疗可保持Polg缺陷小鼠的运动协调性并延长其生存期
papers.author: Zanin, S.
papers.summary: POLG mutations are the most common single nuclear gene cause of mitochondrial disease. POLG disease spans a spectrum of clinical presentations with variable age of onset and severity. Early-onset disease is often severe and fatal (e.g., Alpers syndrome, myocerebrohepatopathy), while late-onset disease can be relatively mild (e.g., progressive external ophthalmoplegia). POLG disease is incurable, with few symptomatic treatments available, none of which can prevent its progression. Gene replacement therapy has the potential to halt or prevent POLG disease, but its development has been hindered by the large size of the POLG cDNA and the scarcity of suitable mouse models. Here, we developed a bespoke Polg knockout (KO) mouse model by inactivating the Polg locus in parvalbumin-expressing neurons (e.g., Purkinje cells) and fast-twitch skeletal muscle fibers. KO mice developed progressive motor coordination deficits, respiratory chain deficiency in Purkinje cells and skeletal muscle, and died prematurely. We also developed nine AAV-based gene therapy vectors and confirmed their ability to deliver and express the human POL{gamma}A protein in different mouse tissues. A single high-dose administration of either of two lead candidates into Polg KO neonates preserved respiratory chain activity in Purkinje cells and skeletal muscle, delayed the onset of motor coordination deficits, and extended lifespan. Thus, our work provides preclinical proof of concept for gene replacement therapy for POLG disease, establishing the feasibility of this approach and laying the foundation for further development in the field.
papers.translated_summary: POLG突变是线粒体疾病最常见的单核基因病因。POLG疾病涵盖一系列临床表现，发病年龄和严重程度各异。早发型疾病通常严重且致命（如Alpers综合征、肌脑肝病），而晚发型疾病可能相对轻微（如进行性眼外肌麻痹）。POLG疾病无法治愈，可用的对症治疗极少，且均无法阻止其进展。基因替代疗法有潜力阻止或预防POLG疾病，但其开发受到POLG cDNA尺寸过大以及缺乏合适小鼠模型的阻碍。在此，我们通过在小清蛋白表达神经元（如浦肯野细胞）和快肌骨骼肌纤维中失活Polg基因座，开发了一种定制的Polg敲除（KO）小鼠模型。KO小鼠出现进行性运动协调障碍、浦肯野细胞和骨骼肌中的呼吸链缺陷，并过早死亡。我们还开发了九种基于AAV的基因治疗载体，并确认了它们在不同小鼠组织中递送和表达人POLγA蛋白的能力。将两种先导候选载体中的任一种以单次高剂量给予Polg KO新生小鼠，均能保持浦肯野细胞和骨骼肌中的呼吸链活性、延迟运动协调障碍的发生并延长寿命。因此，我们的工作为POLG疾病的基因替代疗法提供了临床前概念验证，确立了该方法的可行性，并为该领域的进一步开发奠定了基础。

papers.title: Convergent Genomic Signatures of Selection in Thar: Genetic trade-offs for desert survival
papers.translated_title: 沙漠羚羊中趋同的基因组选择特征：沙漠生存的遗传权衡
papers.author: Rathod, S. M.
papers.summary: Background: Desert environments provide a setting for natural biological experiments to cope up with simultaneous stressors of extreme temperatures, aridity, UV exposure, and limited food resources. Biological adaptations that support living in such an environment could become liabilities when the environment and lifestyle change due to gene-environment mismatch. We explored whether genetically and culturally diverse endogamous native populations of the Thar exhibit convergent signatures of selection to desert conditions and whether the selected loci have implications in traits and disease susceptibilities relevant to non-native transitions. Results: We report 348 high-confidence variants across 45 candidate genes from a study on 176 individuals from eight genetically distinct Thar populations. These genes identified from humans and other desert inhabitants display convergent evolution with multiple selection scans (PBSn1, Tajima`s D, iHS, and XPEHH) in diverse Thar populations. Prominent genes include ZNF385D, SGCZ, SARDH, SLC12A3, etc. Selected variants essential in the desert environment were associated with complex traits like lipid metabolism, hypertension, renal and cardiovascular diseases, and addiction in GWAS and PheWAS. Noteworthy, in a syntenic locus, eQTLs in SARDH, which modulates DBH implicated in addiction, suggest a potential link with survival advantage in an uncertain desert environment. Likewise, a selected variant (rs7204044) in SLC12A3, implicated in hypertension in non-desert populations, seems to be a key to water-salt homeostasis in desert natives. Conclusions: These findings suggest that variants linked to adaptive traits in desert conditions could be linked to maladaptation in an altered environment. This has potential health consequences in climatic and lifestyle transitions among native inhabitants.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：沙漠环境为自然生物学实验提供了场景，以应对极端温度、干旱、紫外线暴露和有限食物资源等同时存在的压力源。支持在这种环境中生存的生物学适应，当环境与生活方式因基因-环境失配而改变时，可能变为负担。我们探讨了塔尔地区遗传和文化上多样化的内婚制原住民群体是否表现出对沙漠条件的趋同选择信号，以及所选位点是否对与非原住民转变相关的性状和疾病易感性具有影响。结果：我们报告了来自8个遗传上不同的塔尔人群176个个体的研究中，45个候选基因中的348个高置信度变异。这些从人类和其他沙漠居民中鉴定出的基因，在多样化的塔尔人群中通过多次选择扫描（PBSn1、Tajima's D、iHS和XPEHH）显示出趋同进化。突出的基因包括ZNF385D、SGCZ、SARDH、SLC12A3等。在沙漠环境中至关重要的所选变异，在GWAS和PheAS中与脂质代谢、高血压、肾脏和心血管疾病以及成瘾等复杂性状相关。值得注意的是，在一个共线性位点中，SARDH的eQTLs（其调节与成瘾有关的DBH）暗示了与不确定沙漠环境中生存优势的潜在联系。同样，SLC12A3中的一个所选变异（rs7204044），在非沙漠人群中与高血压有关，似乎是沙漠原住民水盐稳态的关键。结论：这些发现表明，与沙漠条件下适应性性状相关的变异可能与改变环境中的适应不良有关。这对原住民在气候和生活方式转变中的健康具有潜在后果。

papers.title: SAM-Dependent Precursor Peptide Engagement by Darobactin Maturase DarE
papers.translated_title: Darobactin成熟酶DarE对SAM依赖的前体肽识别
papers.author: Zhu, W.
papers.summary: Radical S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) enzymes that synthesize structurally constrained ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) with therapeutic potential mostly do so by employing a dedicated RiPP recognition element (RRE). With the growing number of RRE-free maturases discovered, how these enzymes engage their substrates remains largely unexplored. In this work, we mapped substrate-enzyme interactions in DarE, an RRE-free radical SAM enzyme that installs the C-C and C-O-C crosslinks of the antibiotic darobactin during the first step of darobactin biosynthesis. Using anaerobic hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS), we simultaneously resolved specific regions within the enzyme and its precursor peptide substrate, DarA, across five complex states. The N-terminal extension and part of the TIM-barrel domain of DarE, along with the leader region of DarA, become protected, revealing the peptide-engagement interface. Additional protection emerged only in the presence of SAM, identifying SAM as a key contributor to precursor-peptide engagement in an RRE-free RiPP maturase. Electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy further demonstrated precursor peptide-dependent perturbations of the chemical environment of the iron-sulfur clusters. These findings suggest that SAM-dependent peptide engagement, mediated in part by the N-terminal extension of the radical SAM enzyme, provides an alternative mechanism for precursor-peptide recognition in RRE-free RiPP maturases. Our work also demonstrates the utility of anaerobic HDX-MS for characterizing protein-peptide-small molecule interactions in oxygen-sensitive metalloenzymes.
papers.translated_summary: 合成结构受限、具有治疗潜力的核糖体合成及翻译后修饰肽（RiPPs）的自由基S-腺苷甲硫氨酸（SAM）酶，大多通过使用专用的RiPP识别元件（RRE）来实现这一过程。随着越来越多无RRE成熟酶的发现，这些酶如何与其底物结合在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们绘制了DarE中的底物-酶相互作用，DarE是一种无RRE的自由基SAM酶，在达罗巴汀生物合成的第一步中安装抗生素达罗巴汀的C-C和C-O-C交联。利用厌氧氢-氘交换质谱（HDX-MS），我们同时在五种复合物状态下解析了酶及其前体肽底物DarA内的特定区域。DarE的N端延伸和TIM桶结构域的一部分，以及DarA的前导区域，变得受到保护，揭示了肽结合界面。额外的保护仅在SAM存在时出现，表明SAM是无RRE RiPP成熟酶中前体肽结合的关键贡献者。电子顺磁共振波谱进一步证明了前体肽依赖性的铁硫簇化学环境扰动。这些发现表明，部分由自由基SAM酶的N端延伸介导的SAM依赖性肽结合，为无RRE RiPP成熟酶中的前体肽识别提供了一种替代机制。我们的工作还证明了厌氧HDX-MS在表征氧敏感金属酶中蛋白质-肽-小分子相互作用方面的实用性。

papers.title: Glycoform Distributions and Heparan Sulfate Binding of Intact SARS-CoV-2 Spike Variants by DIA-ECCR Native Mass Spectrometry
papers.translated_title: 完整SARS-CoV-2刺突变异体的糖型分布与硫酸乙酰肝素结合：DIA-ECCR天然质谱分析
papers.author: Xu, Z.
papers.summary: Glycosylation influences the structure, immunogenicity, and evolutionary selection of the SARS CoV 2 spike protein (S), but its extensive heterogeneity has hindered characterization of intact glycoform distributions. Here, we illustrate a data-independent analysis - electron capture charge reduction (DIA-ECCR) native mass spectrometry workflow for direct analysis of intact spike glycoforms across multiple variants. DIA-ECCR resolves variant-dependent differences in glycoform distributions and higher mass subpopulations. Monte Carlo simulations based on published site-specific bottom-up glycoproteomic data reproduce the central mass of the D614G experimental distribution and support a connection between intact and bottom-up measurements, while the broader experimental distributions and a second Gamma subpopulation indicate heterogeneity not captured by the simulations Mass photometry and charge detection mass spectrometry provide orthogonal measurements consistent with the DIA-ECCR results. DIA-ECCR also resolves mass shifts associated with binding of truncated heparan sulfate, demonstrating analysis of a heterogeneous protein:ligand complex. Together, these results outline a practical workflow that combines DIA-ECCR with native mass spectrometry (nMS) for characterizing intact glycoform distributions and ligand binding in highly heterogeneous glycoprotein assemblies, with potential applications in antigen characterization, vaccine design, and biopharmaceutical quality control.
papers.translated_summary: 糖基化影响SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白（S）的结构、免疫原性和进化选择，但其广泛的异质性阻碍了对完整糖型分布的表征。在此，我们展示了一种数据非依赖分析——电子捕获电荷减少（DIA-ECCR）天然质谱工作流程，用于直接分析多种变异株的完整刺突糖型。DIA-ECCR分辨出糖型分布和高质量亚群中变异株依赖的差异。基于已发表的位点特异性自下而上糖蛋白质组学数据的蒙特卡洛模拟再现了D614G实验分布的中心质量，并支持完整测量与自下而上测量之间的联系，而更宽泛的实验分布和第二个Gamma亚群则表明模拟未能捕获的异质性。质量光度法和电荷检测质谱法提供了与DIA-ECCR结果一致的 orthogonal 测量。DIA-ECCR还分辨出与截短硫酸乙酰肝素结合相关的质量偏移，展示了对异质性蛋白质:配体复合物的分析。总之，这些结果勾勒出一个将DIA-ECCR与天然质谱（nMS）相结合的实用工作流程，用于表征高度异质性糖蛋白组装体中的完整糖型分布和配体结合，在抗原表征、疫苗设计和生物制药质量控制中具有潜在应用。

papers.title: Crystal structure of the first de novo designed phosphotriesterase ZAPP-1
papers.translated_title: 首个从头设计的磷酸三酯酶ZAPP-1的晶体结构
papers.author: Woodbury, S. M.
papers.summary: Designing a de novo phosphotriesterase requires scaffolding a dinuclear metal center bound by six catalytic residues, including a post-translationally carbamylated lysine, in a pocket that must also bind a small, flexible organophosphate and orient it for hydrolysis. We recently met this challenge using RFdiffusion3 to design the first de novo phosphotriesterases, and biochemically characterized our first hit, ZAPP-1 [1]. Here we report two crystal structures of ZAPP-1 at 1.42 and 2.28 [A] resolution. The crystal structures are nearly identical to the design model scaffold (C RMSD = 0.69, 0.71, and 0.99 [A] for three copies across two independent crystals), and the higher-resolution crystal assembles the dinuclear Zn(II) site in the designed pocket with carbamylated K16. The catalytic residues are near the designed geometry but demonstrate flexibility across the structures, albeit mostly rotameric (C{beta} RMSD [≤] 0.8 [A] for both copies in form 1). AlphaFold3 predicts the designed catalytic conformation with substrate bound and the observed crystallographic deviations without it, suggesting an induced-fit mechanism upon substrate binding. Together with prior biochemical characterization, there is strong evidence that ZAPP-1 functions as designed, validating the high precision achievable with our RFdiffusion3 design pipeline, but the structures suggest that future design should better preorganize the active site. The ability to design experimentally accurate and increasingly sophisticated enzymes directly from the computer should enable a new future of programmable catalysis and chemistry.
papers.translated_summary: 设计一个从头开始的磷酸三酯酶需要搭建一个由六个催化残基结合的双核金属中心，其中包括一个翻译后氨甲酰化的赖氨酸，且该中心位于一个口袋中，这个口袋还必须结合一个小而灵活的有机磷酸酯并使其定向以进行水解。我们最近利用RFdiffusion3应对了这一挑战，设计了首批从头磷酸三酯酶，并对我们的第一个命中物ZAPP-1进行了生化表征[1]。在此我们报道ZAPP-1的两个晶体结构，分辨率分别为1.42和2.28[Å]。晶体结构与设计模型骨架几乎相同（两个独立晶体中三个拷贝的C RMSD分别为0.69、0.71和0.99[Å]），较高分辨率的晶体在设计的口袋中以氨甲酰化的K16组装了双核Zn(II)位点。催化残基接近设计的几何构型，但在各结构中表现出灵活性，尽管主要是旋转异构体（形式1中两个拷贝的C{β} RMSD[≤]0.8[Å]）。AlphaFold3预测了结合底物时设计的催化构象以及无底物时观察到的晶体学偏差，提示底物结合时存在诱导契合机制。结合先前的生化表征，有强有力的证据表明ZAPP-1按设计发挥作用，验证了我们的RFdiffusion3设计流程可实现的高精度，但这些结构表明未来的设计应更好地预组织活性位点。直接从计算机设计实验上精确且日益复杂的酶的能力，应能开启可编程催化和化学的新未来。

papers.title: Multi-Layer Functional Metabolomics Reveals Chemical Interactions Between the Plant-Associated Bacterium Serratia marcescens and Phytophthora
papers.translated_title: 多层功能代谢组学揭示植物相关细菌粘质沙雷菌与疫霉之间的化学相互作用
papers.author: Herrera Rosero, D.
papers.summary: Oomycete pathogens of the genus Phytophthora cause devastating crop losses worldwide, highlighting the need for novel biocontrol agents. Here, we developed a multi-layer functional metabolomics workflow that incorporates an LC-MS/MS-based metal infusion assay in combination with microfractionation-based bioassays against Phytophthora infestans and metal-binding assays to map bioactivity from Serratia marcescens extracts. MS/MS analysis and feature-based molecular networking supported the annotation of activity-associated metabolites, including prodigiosin, serratiochelins, and an uncharacterized putative serratiochelin analog designated serratiochelin G. Complementary chrome azurol S assays and post-column iron infusion provided evidence of iron-binding properties. Comparative genomic analysis and L-lysine supplementation supported a proposed biosynthetic origin of serratiochelin G involving cadaverine incorporation. This workflow enables metabolite prioritization by integrating non-targeted LC-MS/MS with chromatographically resolved bioactivity and complementary functional assays.
papers.translated_summary: 疫霉属卵菌病原体在全球范围内造成毁灭性作物损失，凸显了对新型生物防治剂的需求。在此，我们开发了一种多层功能代谢组学工作流程，该流程将基于LC-MS/MS的金属灌注测定与基于微分离的生物测定相结合，针对致病疫霉进行活性检测，并通过金属结合测定来定位粘质沙雷氏菌提取物中的生物活性。MS/MS分析和基于特征分子的网络分析支持了对活性相关代谢物的注释，包括灵菌红素、serratiochelins以及一种未表征的推定serratiochelin类似物，命名为serratiochelin G。互补的铬天青S测定和柱后铁灌注提供了铁结合特性的证据。比较基因组分析和L-赖氨酸补充支持了涉及尸胺掺入的serratiochelin G生物合成起源的推测。该工作流程通过整合非靶向LC-MS/MS与色谱分离的生物活性和互补功能测定，实现了代谢物的优先级排序。

papers.title: Mechanistic Insights into ADAR1-p110 Nuclear Import: A Dual-Interface Interaction with Transportin-1
papers.translated_title: ADAR1-p110核输入的机制洞察：与Transportin-1的双界面相互作用
papers.author: Chin, D. H. R.
papers.summary: The human ADAR1 exists as two isoforms: the predominantly cytoplasmic-localized p150, recognized for its role in suppression of aberrant immune activation, and the predominantly nuclear-localized p110 (missing the N terminal Z domain), whose biological functions remain less understood but are thought to rely heavily on its subcellular localization. Despite its structural similarity to the Z domain unique to ADAR1-p150, the functional significance of the Z{beta} domain shared by both isoforms remains unclear. Here, we identify an additional mechanism contributing to the nuclear import of ADAR1-p110 through a dual-interface interaction with transportin-1 (TNPO1), involving both the Z{beta} and dsRBD3 domains of ADAR1. Using cryo-electron microscopy, we show that Z{beta} engages TNPO1 at its canonical cargo-binding groove, while dsRBD3 binds at a peripheral site overlapping the RanGTP binding interface. Structure-guided mutagenesis and biochemical analyses support the contribution of Z{beta} to TNPO1 recognition. Disruption of the interaction between ADAR1 Z{beta} domain and TNPO1 alters the nucleocytoplasmic distribution of ADAR1-p110, resulting in increased cytoplasmic accumulation despite the retention of the previously characterized dsRBD3-associated nuclear localization signal. Furthermore, cytoplasmic redistribution of ADAR1-p110 mutants is accompanied by global suppression of cytosolic innate immune signaling pathways and reduced expression of interferon-stimulated genes. Together, these findings identify ADAR1 Z{beta} as an additional TNPO1-recognition element synergizing with dsRBD3 that contributes to ADAR1-p110 nuclear localization and highlight the relationship between its subcellular distribution and immune regulatory activity.
papers.translated_summary: 人类ADAR1存在两种异构体：主要定位于细胞质的p150，因其抑制异常免疫激活的作用而被认识；以及主要定位于细胞核的p110（缺失N端Z结构域），其生物学功能尚不清楚，但被认为高度依赖其亚细胞定位。尽管p110与ADAR1-p150特有的Z结构域在结构上相似，但两种异构体共有的Zβ结构域的功能意义仍不明确。在此，我们鉴定了一种额外机制，该机制通过ADAR1与transportin-1（TNPO1）的双界面相互作用促进ADAR1-p110的核输入，该相互作用涉及ADAR1的Zβ和dsRBD3结构域。利用冷冻电镜，我们显示Zβ以TNPO1的经典货物结合槽与其结合，而dsRBD3则结合于与RanGTP结合界面重叠的外周位点。结构指导的突变分析和生化分析支持Zβ对TNPO1识别的贡献。破坏ADAR1 Zβ结构域与TNPO1之间的相互作用会改变ADAR1-p110的核质分布，导致尽管保留了先前表征的dsRBD3相关核定位信号，细胞质积累仍增加。此外，ADAR1-p110突变体的细胞质再分布伴随着胞质先天免疫信号通路的整体抑制以及干扰素刺激基因表达的降低。总之，这些发现将ADAR1 Zβ鉴定为一种额外的TNPO1识别元件，其与dsRBD3协同作用，促进ADAR1-p110的核定位，并强调了其亚细胞分布与免疫调节活性之间的关系。

papers.title: ProlateNet: Sampling-rate transfer of convolutional networks with a weights-only certificate for physiological signals
papers.translated_title: ProlateNet：具有仅权重证书的卷积网络采样率迁移用于生理信号
papers.author: Cui, H.
papers.summary: A central goal of physiological signal analysis is to train a model once and deploy it across recording systems. However, these systems sample EEG and ECG at different rates, and a network trained at one rate loses accuracy at the others. Continuous-kernel networks were built to solve this problem, but published ones still fail at unseen rates, and no existing method can certify a trained model before deployment. In this study, we propose ProlateNet, which builds kernels from prolate spheroidal wave functions to suppress aliasing across sampling rates and certifies a trained model from its weights alone. Across fourteen first-layer designs trained at one rate on three public EEG and ECG datasets, the published continuous-kernel layers FlexConv and sampling-frequency-independent (SFI) convolution show mean worst drops of 0.18 and 0.35 macro-F1 on SEED. ProlateNet is the only design that is stable and accurate on all three datasets with an error bound fixed before training, and its mean worst drop is at most 0.003. Without target-rate recordings, its certificate ranks the continuous-kernel designs on SEED by measured transfer with Spearman {rho} = 0.92, against 0.68 for energy above the training Nyquist frequency. Overall, ProlateNet shows that controlling aliasing enables convolutional networks to transfer across sampling rates and provides principled guidance for building physiological signal models that are trained once and deployed across recording systems.
papers.translated_summary: 生理信号分析的一个核心目标是训练一次模型即可将其部署到不同的记录系统上。然而，这些系统对EEG和ECG的采样率不同，在一个采样率下训练的网络在其他采样率下会损失精度。连续核网络正是为解决这一问题而构建的，但已发表的此类网络在未见过的采样率下仍然失效，且现有方法都无法在部署前对训练好的模型进行认证。在本研究中，我们提出ProlateNet，它利用长球面波函数构建核，以抑制跨采样率的混叠，并仅凭权重即可对训练好的模型进行认证。在三个公开EEG和ECG数据集上以单一采样率训练的十四种第一层设计中，已发表的连续核层FlexConv和采样频率无关（SFI）卷积在SEED上表现出平均最差下降分别为0.18和0.35的宏F1。ProlateNet是唯一在全部三个数据集上均稳定且准确、且误差界在训练前即已固定的设计，其平均最差下降至多为0.003。在没有目标采样率记录的情况下，其认证依据实测迁移性能对SEED上的连续核设计进行排序，Spearman ρ = 0.92，而基于训练奈奎斯特频率以上能量的排序为0.68。总体而言，ProlateNet表明，控制混叠能够使卷积网络跨采样率迁移，并为构建训练一次即可跨记录系统部署的生理信号模型提供了有原则的指导。
